762.title: A clearer "more" sign, the stock count's name above its controls on phones, tooltips that tap-and-go
humanItems: At phone width, the settings tabs and the dashboard's metadata row show a clearly visible sign at the edge
The stock count at phone width: each row shows the item's name on top, and under it the unit, the counted
At phone width, tap a blocked button (dev catalog sample): the tooltip shows; tap anywhere else, or scroll:

any page with a small floating box · open it on a row near the top and on a row near the bottom of the screen · it is as wide as its text, sits right above or below the row, and is never cut off — here: the product list's warning triangle at phone width, tapped on the first and the last visible row.

decisions.text: behaviour: in a phone-wide window used with a mouse, hover still opens the tooltip and a click then keeps it until the next press; only a device with no hover loses hover — reverse: return early from onPointerEnter in tap mode and update the hover-based restaurant menu specs

behaviour: on phones the stock count's product column heading takes its own line, so the other headings stay over their controls — reverse: drop .stock-count__name-head from the phone rule and restore the name track in mobileGridTemplate_
behaviour: on phones the line between an item's name and its controls is removed so the two read as one row — reverse: delete the phone rule on .stock-count__name
behaviour: the 'more' badge uses the teal --color-primary-strong as the theme's accent, not the unused violet --color-accent — reverse: swap the two colour tokens on .sr-more__badge
